pick.name: Hacker News (Show HN)
pick.what: Show HN post for something people can try
pick.why: Free, highest-intent audience for dev tools, MCP servers, open-core and B2B AI; strict quality rules reward real products
pick.free_limits: Free; no sign-up wall, no landing pages, no vote rings

alts.name: Product Hunt
alts.why: Best for B2C/prosumer apps; free; launch 12:01 am PT; no company accounts

alts.name: Peerlist Launchpad
alts.why: Builder network, mostly software engineers; free launch, optional USD 29/day featured slot; only top 5 get a (rel=ugc) link
alts.free_limits: Free weekly launch; one-time ID verification ~USD 19

candidates.name: Anthropic Connectors Directory
candidates.verdict: See marketplaces slot: biggest channel for MCP/Claude plugins

decision: Launch dev and AI-infrastructure products on Show HN, consumer apps on Product Hunt, and cross-post every launch to Peerlist and relevant subreddits the same week.

verify.note: Show HN rules confirmed: no sign-up walls, no landing pages, no voting rings. Rules now also discourage 'quickly generated one-off projects', which matters for Claude-built launches.
